Make Your First AI Video

Beginner class · Taught by Nigel Tan

Bring a simple idea for a short video. In this planned beginner class, Nigel will show you how to shape a script, plan your shots, and review the subtitles before you share it.

Try a class exercise

Dates and enrolment will be announced here.

Inside

What we’ll practise

  • Turn one idea into a 30-second script
  • Sketch a three-shot storyboard
  • Review captions and make a final cut

Class notebook

A warm-up before class

Imagine filming a neighbourhood kopi stall. Write one line for the opening, one detail worth a close-up, and one line to end on. Read all three aloud. Which line could you show with your camera instead?
